name: Raspberry Chia Yogurt Jar
ingredients: 1½ cups plain low-fat Greek yogurt or unsweetened soy yogurt
steps: Stir the chia seeds, vanilla and mashed raspberries into the yogurt.
Divide into two jars, top with the whole raspberries and oats.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight so the chia thickens.
note: Raspberries are among the highest-fibre fruits; no sweetener is needed.
